title: Talk Is Cheap, Show Me Your Colors: Low-Budget Consistency Auditing for Aggregated LLM Services

creators.name: He, Xiguan
creators.affiliation: College of Information, Yunnan University of Chinese Medicine

creators.name: Li, Siqi
creators.affiliation: College of Information, Yunnan University of Chinese Medicine

description:
Organizations routing production workloads through aggregated large language model (LLM) brokers rely on declared model identifiers, yet the backend serving each request remains hidden. We present HuePrint, a black-box framework that audits brokered endpoint consistency without model weights, log-probabilities, or provider dispatch tables. HuePrint elicits compact multilingual color coordinates (#RRGGBB and R,G,B) to sample each checkpoint's intrinsic landing priors in continuous RGB space while remaining resilient to residual pre-answer reasoning output when no-think flags or answer-only directives fail.

  • Sample-efficient separation & competitor parity: Across 38,688 cloud responses spanning 56 endpoints and 12 backends (Datasets A–E and Studies S1–S5), HuePrint lowers 30-call/side equal error rates (EERs) over single-word baselines from 4.52–5.23% to 0.94–1.00% on the development cohort and from 6.25–8.04% to 3.49–5.00% across 20 locked endpoints (0.00% at 60 and 150 calls/side, respectively). On the same 20 endpoints, 30-call HuePrint (0.0068 USD query cost) averages 5.18% within-family EER across all ten balanced splits (0.00–7.89%; matched split 0.00%), outperforming open-set LLMmap (10.53–34.39%) and cost-matched long-form continuation kernels (11.09–19.47%) while avoiding safety refusals and running over 15,000× faster on local CPU (0.08–0.31 ms vs. 4,701.9 ms).
  • Continuous RGB geometry & cross-host matching: Regularized RGB energy halves shallow 56-endpoint census EER relative to exact-hex divergence (5.36% vs. 10.71%) with Lipschitz stability under bounded coordinate shifts, while a multi-scale hybrid composite cuts cross-provider EER across 12 independent serving stacks from 16.67% to 5.93%.
  • Drift-tolerant calibration & sequential monitoring: Across 21-day cross-gateway transfers, budget-matched frozen thresholds catch 182/182 swaps with 0/14 false flags after enrollment self-centering (1/14 raw vs. 6/14 strict equality-test rejections). Zero-bootstrap clipped U-statistic energy ratios remove enrollment resampling, private pool subsampling cuts per-prompt reuse 4.0×, and two-stage confirmation reduces false alerts from 14 to 1 across 100 same-label windows while flagging 186/190 within-family swaps under 0.01 USD expected cost.

Included artifacts (v3.0.1): Complete 32-page merged preprint (HuePrint_Preprint.pdf), standalone 12-page IEEE Computer Society main manuscript (HuePrint_Main_Manuscript.pdf), 20-page Supplementary Material (HuePrint_Supplementary_Material.pdf), and a self-contained offline replication archive (HuePrint_Replication_Package.zip) containing standalone TeX sources (HuePrint_Main.tex and HuePrint_Supplement.tex), all 15 SHA-256-locked JSONL corpora, multilingual prompt batteries, pure-NumPy analysis scripts, and unit tests (58 baseline plus 10 Study S5 locked files).
